title: Finally seeing the light at the end of the tunnel with my indie project
author: eRickoCS
selftext:
After 6 years deep in the CS world and finishing up my studies, I’m finally reaching a huge milestone.

I’ve been tinkering with Unity on and off for about 4 years, but last year I finally took the plunge and started my first "big" project: BAUSFIGHT.

I’m currently developing this as a solo indie dev. It’s a 2D top-down multiplayer battle royale with a retro pixel-art aesthetic and class-based combat.

I wanted to make this post mainly to say that I am genuinely grateful for this community. It’s refreshing to have a space where you won’t be "spit at" for just mentioning that you use AI in your workflow.

Honestly, without AI, I don’t think I would have ever cracked the netcode logic for this game. Multiplayer is a beast, but being able to use AI to directly ask why a specific block of code isn't doing what I want, or having it help me bridge the gap when I hit a wall has been a total game changer. It’s taken me from being stuck for days to actually making progress.

I’m really excited because the first playable demo is just around the corner. If anyone else here is using AI to help navigate the solo-dev grind, I’d love to hear how it’s helping you push through your own hurdles. Thanks for keeping this place open-minded!

comments.author: CapyArchitect
comments.body: This is looking great! Where do you want to host it ?

replies.author: eRickoCS
replies.body: It's gonna be on Steam. I'm utilizing Steamworks/FishySteamworks to make a hybrid of server and client authority. Something that feels competitive but is still casual at it's heart 😃

replies.author: CapyArchitect

replies.author: eRickoCS
replies.body:
Demo will have first gamemode, best-of-x pvp 2 teams style, 2 to 8 players and 4 classes. Later on I'll expand to bigger and more dynamic gamemodes. 

If this sounds like your kind of game, feel free to wishlist BAUSFIGHT on Steam to stay in the loop! I'm also just starting up a Discord hub for development updates, feedback and to find ppl to play with, link is on the Steam page ❤️
